```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# Cleaning and tidying the dataset
ny_noaa_df = 
  ny_noaa |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    day = day(date),
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  ) 
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Snowfall distribution by year

```{r}
ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(snow > 0, snow < 100) |>
  mutate(year = factor(year)) |>
  plot_ly(y = ~ snow, color = ~year, 
          type = "box", colors = "viridis")
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Average Maximum Temperature and Average Snow in January by Year  

```{r}
ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(month == 1) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    jan_tmax_average = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    jan_snow_average = mean(snow, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year, y = ~jan_tmax_average, type = "scatter", color = ~jan_snow_average, mode = "markers", alpha = 0.5, colors = "viridis"
  )
  
```

### Total Recorded Snow Fall Per Station in 2000

```{r}
ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(year == 2000) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  summarize(
    sum_snow_id = sum(snow, na.rm = TRUE),
    average_tmax_id = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  drop_na(average_tmax_id) |> 
  arrange(average_tmax_id) |>
  mutate(id = factor(id, levels = id)) |>     
  plot_ly(x = ~id, 
          y = ~sum_snow_id, 
          type = "bar", 
          marker = list(
            color = ~average_tmax_id, 
            colorscale = "Viridis", 
            showscale = TRUE, 
            colorbar = list(title = "Mean Tmax")
          )
    )
